source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Μάξιμος και Βικτωρίνος οι Ιερομάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries two head names, «Αγιος Μαξιμος ο Ιερομαρτυρας (; - 384)» and «Αγιος Βικτωρινος ο Ιερομαρτυρας (; - 384)», so it is two folders. It carries no asterisk, though it does hedge the two ranks with «Σύμφωνα με την παράδοση». None of the corpus's men of either name is a martyr of Évreux; note that `anastasius-of-brescia`, a new folder of 05-20, is of the same city and another century. The day page's line calls both of them Ιερομάρτυρες and the body calls them Μάρτυρες, which is why `types` carries `hieromartyr` — the rank the head lines give them. The page makes him the deacon of the pair, «ο Άγιος Βικτωρίνος διάκονος», under the same «Σύμφωνα με την παράδοση», so `deacon` is in his `types` on the page's own hedged word. The corpus keeps two other men of this name and neither is he: `victorinus-companion-of-agapitus`, a soldier-martyr kept on the Greek 18 Φεβρουαρίου and known only from a mention in Agapitus of Synnada's memoir, and `victorinus-of-corinth`.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
